name: HPC-QC integration and resource management
blurb: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system.

touchstones.text: integrating quantum processors into HPC centres and job schedulers
quantum resource management, queueing and QPU-as-a-resource
hybrid quantum-classical workflows with HPC co-scheduling
monitoring and software interfaces between HPC and quantum hardware
